en.description:
Joker Party is a classic Old Maid card game designed for family and friends.

With simple rules and familiar gameplay,
players take turns drawing cards, forming pairs,
and trying not to be the one left holding the Joker.
It’s easy to learn and fun for players of all ages.

The game supports 2–6 players,
with both offline play and online matches through Game Center.
You can also choose between one or two decks to match your preferred pace.

A highlight of Joker Party is Joker customization.
Using Genmoji, you can personalize the Joker card and add a friendly, playful touch to every game.

Whether it’s a family gathering or a casual get-together with friends,
Joker Party offers a simple and enjoyable way to play together.
en.releaseNotes:
[A Brand-New Table]

A New Game Table: Opponents sit around the table, so you can see at a glance whose turn it is and who you draw from.

Easier Drawing: Tap a card back to lift it, then tap again or swipe up to take it. No more mis-taps, even with a big hand.

Smarter Opponents: In single-player mode, each opponent has their own personality, reads the game, and chats with you at the table.

iPhone Duo Support: Play in landscape or portrait when unfolded. The table adapts automatically.

More Improvements: A shuffle button, a confirmation before leaving, and "Play Again" with rankings when the game ends.
en.subtitle: Customize your Joker.
